light.notes: paper is the syntax background hsl(230,1%,98%); bg, chip, and border are derived steps below it (the syntax palette publishes one surface); ink mono-1, mono-2, mono-3; amber and yellow are the two orange hues; series two is cyan. on-green and on-yellow are pinned to white: the ink rule would take mono-1 on them, a light-mode change left to MAD-378

dark.notes: paper is the syntax background hsl(220,13%,18%); bg and chip are the One Dark UI panel steps; border the selection colour, border-hover the gutter; ink mono-1, mono-2, mono-3
